structure.layout: single-column marketing landing page: sticky top nav with mega-menu dropdowns, split hero (headline + CTAs / triangle mark / expanding capability list), logo strip, three alternating customer-story sections (big heading + product screenshot + stat sentence + feature list), 'Recently shipped' bento card grid, centered closing CTA, 12-column link-directory footer

aesthetics.typography: Geist Sans for everything (headlines 56-64px at weight ~450 with tight negative tracking, body/nav 14-16px); Geist Mono for small technical labels ('ALL SYSTEMS NORMAL.', v0 link)
aesthetics.typeScale: Very high contrast: 64px H1 and 56px section H2s at medium weight against 14-16px body and 24px stat sentences; minimal intermediate sizes

notes: Near-monochrome Vercel/Geist design: #fafafa page, near-black #171717 text and primary pill buttons (fully rounded, 9999px radius), white outlined secondary pills; cards 6px radius with hairline borders. Hero centerpiece is the solid black Vercel triangle. Customer-story sections alternate heading/screenshot alignment (left, right, left) and fade product screenshots into the background with bottom gradients; stat sentences use two-tone text (dark lead, grey tail). Much of the capture below y≈2600 is blank because scroll-reveal content did not render; Mintlify section, Recently shipped bento, closing CTA and footer were verified via DOM and the live page. Customer logo strip under hero has no codebook entry (proposed 'logo-cloud'). Footer includes a live status link ('ALL SYSTEMS NORMAL.' in blue mono), theme switcher and a 'View as AI agent' button.
